title: CacheBlend: Fast Large Language Model Serving for RAG with Cached Knowledge Fusion - Validation

environment.hardware: CPU-only sandbox; no NVIDIA GPU available (torch.cuda.is_available() == False, device_count == 0). Paper-grade end-to-end inference requires at least one NVIDIA A40-class GPU with >=16 GB VRAM.
environment.software: Python 3.11.15, PyTorch 2.12.0 (CPU build), transformers 5.8.1, numpy 2.4.4, pytest 9.0.3, rouge_score (per requirements.txt). Plan target was transformers >=4.40,<4.46 but 5.8.1 is what is installed; tests pass under it.

tests/test_selective_recompute.py: in-place index_copy preserves unselected, zero-recompute matches pure reuse, full-recompute matches HF forward, BlendConfig defaults (4 tests)
tests/test_metrics.py: normalize_answer, F1 known pairs (word tokenizer), F1 max picks best, Rouge-L known pairs (4 tests)
tests/test_datasets.py: 2WikiMQA / Musique / SAMSum loaders, QA prompt assembly, summarization prompt assembly (5 tests)

discrepancies.metric: F1 / Rouge-L drop vs full KV recompute
discrepancies.hypothesis: Not measured. The end-to-end quality run requires loading Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2 in fp16 on a CUDA device; this sandbox has neither a GPU nor HuggingFace credentials. Algorithmic correctness of the three pieces that determine this metric (V-deviation, top-r% selection, RoPE recovery, in-place index_copy, F1/Rouge-L scorers) is verified by unit tests, so once GPU + HF access are available the run is expected to produce a value within the paper's <=0.03 worst-case tolerance band.

discrepancies.metric: F1 / Rouge-L improvement vs full KV reuse
discrepancies.hypothesis: Not measured for the same hardware reason. baselines.full_reuse_generate (PromptCache-style) and baselines.cacheblend_generate are both implemented and exercised by unit tests at the layer level; only the end-to-end generation pass requires GPU.

Not measured. Additionally note that the paper's <=0.002 stability claim is on Yi-34B (Figure 16); the plan targets Mistral-7B as a proxy, so the value of this comparison on Mistral-7B is informational and the tolerance was widened to 0.03 in plan.json.

Explicitly out of scope per plan.json. The two-thread Fusor pipelining, custom xformers attention swap, and vLLM scheduler were not vendored; the HuggingFace-based reproduction runs the model twice for CacheBlend (see CODER_NOTES.md item 2), which is quality-preserving but TTFT-irrelevant. Measuring TTFT here would not be a faithful reproduction of the paper's system.

discrepancies.metric: Per-layer recompute/load latencies and baseline full prefill TTFT
discrepancies.hypothesis: Hardware-bound numbers tied to NVIDIA A40 / NVMe SSD throughput (4.8 GB/s in the paper). Not measurable on a CPU sandbox and out of scope for the quality-only plan.

next_actions: Provision a single NVIDIA A40 (or equivalent: A100, L40, RTX 6000 Ada, RTX 4090 with at least 16 GB VRAM) and export HF_TOKEN with access to mistralai/Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2.
Run scripts/run_smoke.py first to confirm the three strategies (full_recompute, cacheblend, full_reuse) produce non-trivial F1 values on 5 2WikiMQA examples at r=0.15.

Run code/eval/run_eval.py with configs/default.yaml on the full grid: (2WikiMQA, Musique, SAMSum, MultiNews) x {full_recompute, cacheblend, full_reuse} x r in {0.05, 0.10, 0.15, 0.18}, 100 examples each, seeds {0, 1, 2}; report mean +/- std.
Compare measured F1 / Rouge-L delta(cacheblend - full_recompute) against the <=0.03 plan tolerance and delta(cacheblend - full_reuse) against the 0.15-0.35 improvement band.

If the F1 drop vs full recompute exceeds 0.03, ablate: (a) check_layer index (try 0 and 2 in addition to 1), (b) confirm pre-RoPE K capture hook fires on every layer, (c) verify chunk boundaries match the prompt assembly exactly (the bundled wikimqa_s.json includes its own context list).

Pin transformers version: tests currently pass on transformers 5.8.1 but plan.json specified >=4.40,<4.46; if generation behavior differs from the official CacheBlend example/utils.py expectations, downgrade to transformers 4.44 for full fidelity.
Optional (out of plan scope): to attempt TTFT numbers, install the official YaoJiayi/CacheBlend vLLM fork in a separate environment; do not mix with the HF-based quality reproduction.
